text: {"batchcomplete":true,"query":{"pages":[{"pageid":73777642,"ns":0,"title":"Anchor channel","extract":"Anchor channels, invented by Anders Jordahl in 1913, are steel channels cast flush in reinforced concrete elements to allow the installation of channel bolts for the fastening of components.\nAnchor channels consist of steel C-shaped channels and anchors (mostly headed studs) which are connected to the channel by welding or riveting/forging.","description":"Fastener in reinforced concrete construction","descriptionsource":"local"}]}}
